name: swole-cat
description: Swole Cat workout tracker PWA and Android app

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:web && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
